questions.cardText:
[Physics] Why do magnets lose their magnetism when heated?
A. The magnetic domains become misaligned
B. The magnetic field becomes orthogonal
C. The magnet expands too much
Answer: A. Magnets lose their magnetism when heated because the magnetic domains within the material become misaligned. Heating a magnet can cause the thermal energy to disrupt the alignment of these domains, resulting in the loss of magnetism.
questions.de: Was geschieht beim Erhitzen eines Magneten mit der Ausrichtung seiner magnetischen Domänen, sodass er seinen Magnetismus verliert?
questions.en: When a magnet is heated, what happens to the alignment of its magnetic domains that makes it lose its magnetism?
questions.answerDe: Sie gerät durcheinander (die Domänen werden ungeordnet)
questions.answerEn: It is disrupted (the domains become disordered)

timeline.labelEn: Pierre Curie shows that magnetism is lost at a critical temperature, now called the Curie point
timeline.labelDe: Pierre Curie zeigt, dass Magnetismus bei einer kritischen Temperatur verloren geht, dem heutigen Curie-Punkt

questions.notes: Wikipedia (Curie temperature): higher thermal energy has a randomizing effect on aligned magnetic domains; above the Curie point permanent magnetism is lost. Strictly it is the atomic moments' order that breaks down, but the card's answer is the standard textbook explanation.

questions.cardText:
[History] Who was the first female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom?
A. Margaret Thatcher
B. Theresa May
C. Indira Gandhi
Answer: A.
questions.de: Wer war die erste Premierministerin des Vereinigten Königreichs?
questions.en: Who was the first female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom?

timeline.labelEn: Margaret Thatcher serves as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, the first woman in the office
timeline.labelDe: Margaret Thatcher ist Premierministerin des Vereinigten Königreichs, als erste Frau in diesem Amt
